next_actions.title: Counter-notice on the IP complaint
next_actions.body: Validity is weak on the claimant’s side: no registered mark in our category and our listing predates the cited design by 16 months. The pack is assembled; counsel reads it and files.
next_actions.draft: We dispute complaint 8814-2291 in full. The complainant’s registration (filed Mar 2025) covers cookware handle geometry and does not extend to pan bodies. Our listing for the carbon steel skillet 10" first published 14 Nov 2023, sixteen months prior, with the original image set attached. The product is manufactured on our supplier’s standard tooling under the authorisation letter enclosed. We request immediate reinstatement and note that the complainant has filed nine comparable complaints in twelve months, four subsequently withdrawn.

next_actions.title: Correct the condition phrase on nine listings
next_actions.body: Two are suppressed; seven carry the same 2024 template phrase and have not been flagged yet. Fixing only the suppressed pair leaves seven waiting to happen.
next_actions.draft: The phrase "like new performance" has been removed from all nine affected listings and from the source template, replaced with "filtration performance". No condition claim remains in any listing. Diff attached for both suppressed items. We request reinstatement of the two suppressed listings and confirm the remaining seven were corrected proactively.

next_actions.title: Handling-time buffer on weekend orders
next_actions.body: One extra day of handling on Fri–Sun orders. Fixes 78% of the late-shipment cause and the shared 71% of the Walmart on-time cause with one change — and nothing is submitted to anyone.

next_actions.title: Two extra Monday pickers at the East node
next_actions.body: Addresses the 11% of late orders caused by oversize items waiting on a second picker. Costs 3PL labour and does not touch the promise shown at checkout.
